dimensions.description: GUI icon size; not physical area

limitations: 25 C nominal behavior inherited from VA; no temperature/thermal qualification
Sample period is numerical resolution; get_latency returns unavailable
Signal ports do not solve an arbitrary external electrical network
Do not add the same COUT/ESR again in the external load
Constant-current loads can be unserved at zero output; query unserved_load_current
PSRR ripple/analytic noise supported only for TPS7A20; time-domain noise is disabled
